market_question: Will Dan Cox win the 2026 Maryland Governor Republican primary election?
reasoning: Dan Cox won the 2022 primary with Trump's endorsement but lost the general election by a wide margin, which may reduce GOP establishment support. He has not announced a 2026 run, and even if he runs, a contested primary could feature stronger moderate or Trump-aligned challengers. The market-implied 57.5% seems too high given the uncertainty two years out.
evidence_points: 2022 primary win with 52.5% occurred in a divided field and with high-profile Trump endorsement, which may not replicate in 2026.
His 2022 general election loss (by ~30 points) could shift primary voters toward perceived electability.
No official candidacy for 2026 has been declared; if he does not run, YES resolves to NO.
sources_consulted: Open-source news on potential 2026 Maryland governor candidates
